notes.title: Fix & Improve Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed various tutorial issues.
[*] Improved saving and loading:
[*] Products now stay in place properly.
[*] No more products flying around when loading a game.
[*] Loading is now smoother and more accurate.
[*] Fixed a bug that could break the game when restocking.
[*] Hands no longer go through walls after teleporting.
[*] Improved card machine interaction:
[*] Button presses now have a short delay to prevent mistakes.
[*] Swiping the card feels more natural.
[*] Added placement guides when setting up furniture.
[/list]

notes.title: VR Store Simulator Update: Product Indicators and Improved Interactions
notes.content:
Product Indicators: Shelves, fridges, and freezers now show indicators for stocked products.

Improved Placement: Better product placement on furniture.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed issue with cash getting stuck after closing the cash register.

Corrected scaling issue with "SausagePack."

Customers: Slightly faster interaction animations.

UI Adjustments: Moved total price panel on the cash register to the left.

Rewards Update:

Boxing Machine: XP reward increased from 5 to 10, cash reward increased from $5 to $10.

Recycling empty boxes now gives +1 XP and +$1.

New Management Page: Coming soon.

notes.title: VR Store Simulator - Christmas Edition
notes.content:
[h1]VR Store Simulator - Christmas Edition Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310046/54060b0027549d93110bca3549cd10391d067907.png[/img]

Get ready to immerse yourself in the festive spirit with our Christmas Edition update! This holiday season, we've transformed VR Store Simulator into a winter wonderland, complete with enchanting decorations, cheerful music, and exciting new features. Here's what you can look forward to:

[b]What's New[/b]
[list]
[*]Festive Decorations:
The main menu and store are now decked out with Christmas decorations, including a beautiful Christmas tree and gifts outside the store.
[*]Snow and Santa:
Enjoy the magical addition of snow and a visit from Santa on the map.
[*]Queue Management:
Customers now have a waiting timer in queues, offering custom XP rewards and fun dialogues based on their wait times.
[*]Help & Tips Page :
Find all the guidance you need with our new Help & Tips page in the main menu.
[*]Nighttime Indicator :
A new animated alarm clock button helps you manage your store at night.
[*]Save Confirmation :
We've added a "Save Successful" indicator to let you know when your game progress is saved.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[olist]
[*] Product Location
 Customers can now find products easily.
[*] Pricing Issues
 Resolved the glitch where customers got stuck with expensive products.
[*] Card Payment Improvements
Faster and smoother card payment animations for a better shopping experience.
[/olist]
 Celebrate the holidays with our Christmas Edition update and make your VR Store Simulator experience merrier than ever. Happy Holidays and enjoy the festive fun!
